assay: bulk total RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, paired-end NovaSeq X Plus), mouse soleus; featureCounts on GRCm39/GENCODE M33 (S2.6.p2)
primary_estimand: Effect of a combined spaceflight analogue (14-day hindlimb unloading + 1 Gy whole-body X-ray on day 7 + oral corticosterone 5 mg/kg/day) versus pair-fed, sham-irradiated controls on soleus gene expression (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.5.p1, S3.1.p1). This is a disuse/atrophy model; there is no exercise or training arm anywhere in the mouse experiment.
sample_inclusion: 20 male C57BL/6J mice, 10 CONTROL and 10 SPACE, one soleus each (S2.3.p1, FIG1)
planned_contrasts: SPACE vs CONTROL, protein-coding genes (S3.1.p1; paper: 6191 DEGs, 2666 up / 3525 down, FDR < 0.01)
SPACE vs CONTROL, lncRNAs (S3.2.p1; paper: 465 DE lncRNAs, 340 up / 125 down, 'P < 0.01' / -log10FDR > 2)
repeated_measure_unit: none; independent animals (pair-fed controls matched to SPACE mice for food intake, S2.3.p3, but pairing not recorded in GEO)
paper_results: Mstn +1.6, Myh4 +5.1, Myh1 +2.1, Myh7 -1.7, Myh3 -2.1, Ppara -1.9, H19 -2.0, Kcnq1ot1 +0.31, Lncpint +0.86 logFC (S3.1.p2-p5, ABS.p1)
exercise_content: Exercise is mentioned only in the Introduction as a known countermeasure in human bed rest literature (S1.p4); not part of any experiment in this paper.
